5 Days / 4 NightsFully customisable to your calendar.

Three sacred cities, with flights, luxury stays, private travel and meaningful rituals coordinated by your dedicated concierge. Every day is shaped around your pace and preferences.

Flights, personally coordinated

End-to-end domestic flight bookings and seat allocations coordinated directly by your concierge.

Sanctuary & transit

Luxury boutique hotel stays and private, chauffeur-driven intercity transfers, with Force Urbania or Innova Hycross options.

Assisted VIP Darshan

Assistance with authorised VIP or priority Darshan passes to bypass ordinary queues where the temple offers this service.

Your private Ganga

An exclusively reserved private boat for Ganga Aarti and an intimate viewing of all 84 ghats.

Sacred rites, thoughtfully managed

Rudrabhishek, Pind Daan and other chosen Vedic rituals, respectfully coordinated with senior temple priests.

Darshan passes and priority access are subject to temple rules and availability. Boat routes, the full 84-ghat viewing and Aarti arrangements depend on river conditions and local permissions.

YOUR PRIVATE PILGRIMAGE

Your journey. Your personalised quote.

Your personalised quote

Pricing is tailored to your dates, group size, departure city, preferred stays and vehicle. Your written quote itemises airfares, accommodation, transfers and selected temple or ritual charges before you book.

Not included

  • Personal shopping.
  • Bespoke customised add-ons outside the agreed itinerary.
  • Personal gratuities outside the programme.
Explore your daily itinerary

A suggested route through Varanasi, Prayagraj and Ayodhya, with two nights in Varanasi, one in Prayagraj and one in Ayodhya. Your concierge adjusts the daily order around your flights, temple slots and preferences.

  1. 01

    Day 1 · Varanasi

    Arrive and settle into Kashi

    A gentle beginning, with time to rest after your flight.

    Arrival
    Meet your chauffeur for a private airport transfer to your luxury boutique hotel.
    Afternoon
    Check in and unwind, with your arrival arrangements coordinated by your concierge.
    Evening
    Review your Darshan plans, ritual preferences and the days ahead with your concierge.

    Overnight Varanasi · night 1 of 4

  2. 02

    Day 2 · Varanasi

    Darshan, sacred rites and the Ganga

    A day of devotion, with time to pause between experiences.

    Morning
    Visit Kashi Vishwanath with assisted Darshan arrangements and your selected Rudrabhishek or other agreed puja.
    Afternoon
    Rest at your hotel before your private boat journey along the 84 ghats, subject to permitted river routes.
    Evening
    Experience Ganga Aarti from your exclusively reserved boat, followed by your return transfer.

    Overnight Varanasi · night 2 of 4

  3. 03

    Day 3 · Varanasi → Prayagraj

    The sacred confluence

    Travel privately to Prayagraj for time at Triveni Sangam.

    Morning
    Your chauffeur takes you to Prayagraj, with breaks arranged around your comfort.
    Afternoon
    Visit Triveni Sangam, with Pind Daan or other agreed Vedic rites coordinated with senior priests.
    Evening
    Settle into your luxury boutique stay and enjoy an unhurried evening.

    Overnight Prayagraj · night 3 of 4

  4. 04

    Day 4 · Prayagraj → Ayodhya

    A day in the city of devotion

    Continue to Ayodhya, with your temple visit arranged around the available timings.

    Morning
    Travel to Ayodhya in your private, chauffeur-driven vehicle and check in as hotel timings allow.
    Afternoon
    Visit Ram Mandir with concierge assistance, following the temple’s approved access arrangements.
    Evening
    Spend time by the Sarayu before returning to your hotel.

    Overnight Ayodhya · night 4 of 4

  5. 05

    Day 5 · Ayodhya · onward travel

    An effortless onward journey

    A flexible final day, planned around your departure.

    Morning
    Enjoy time at leisure before check-out, depending on your flight schedule.
    Departure
    Your chauffeur provides the agreed airport transfer, with onward domestic flight bookings and seat allocations coordinated by your concierge.
